chunks: Therefore, plan for your place of stay
and do not sell your next life with this world
and give up discussing what you do not know
and speaking about what does not concern you
and keep off the track from which you fear to go astray
because refraining (from moving) when there is fear of straying is better than embarking on dangers
ai.seo_question: What are the key ethical instructions Imam Ali gave to Hasan regarding knowledge and conduct?
ai.summary: Delivered during the transitional period after the Battle of Siffin, this advice underscores the strategic prudence of the Ahl al-Bayt, urging Hasan to preserve his spiritual integrity by avoiding political entanglements and speculative discourse. It highlights the Shia emphasis on 'waiting' (intizar) and caution, where refraining from action in times of uncertainty is valued higher than risking error through overreach.
